entities.summary: Aria Summer Wallace is an American singer, songwriter and actress. She is known for her guest role as Amanda "Mandy" Valdez on the Nickelodeon sitcom iCarly and for her role as Roxy Hunter in the four Nickelodeon Original Movies of the same name.
